title: CAD static FEA case (hw/analysis/cases/<case>/case.yaml)
description: The tunable numbers of a static FEA case, with hard bounds (a violation is an error) and plausibility bands (x-plausible: a miss is the warning plausibility.<field>, never blocking). The material numbers are facts about a real material and have no default; the tunables do. Only fields with a number or a closed value set are described; fea_static.load_case checks the selectors, loads and evidence. Keys keep the names the case files use today, so the unit sits in x-unit: E and yield are in MPa, density in kg/m3, mesh_size in mm, timeout_seconds in seconds

mesh_size_extent_ratio.description: Largest element edge as a fraction of the part's largest extent. The default 0.05 is extent / 20, a starting point that the mesh convergence gate (#56) verifies, not a guarantee. An explicit mesh_size wins when set. The hard bounds are a quarter of the extent and a thousandth of it; warn above a tenth (too coarse) or below a two-hundredth (too many nodes)

mesh_size.description: Largest element edge in mm. An explicit value overrides mesh_size_extent_ratio and has no default of its own. A band relative to the part's largest extent: warn above a tenth of it (too coarse) or below a two-hundredth (too many nodes)

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the FreeCAD job

required_safety_factor.description: The yield safety factor a completed solve must reach; below 1 would accept a failure

material.description: Either the four explicit numbers or the conditions of the part's material profile (profile, conditions, effective_isotropic); fea_conditions checks the profile form

E.description: Young's modulus; the bound is 1200 GPa, diamond's
